# PWA and Offline-First Engineering
Inspect the manifest, cache list, service worker registration, IndexedDB names, sync queue, and Test Mode namespaces. Preserve cache and offline behavior. Update cache versions when offline shell assets change. Avoid caching sensitive authorization responses and verify reconnect, retry, stale-while-revalidate, and logout paths.
